title: The Stranger
description: Tappy is trapped beneath a tarpaulin, but the trail — and a ticket — may lead to answers.
transcript: The stranger looks at you for a moment.
The trail keeps going. Through the yard, then out past the old machinery.
They glance down at themselves and give the tarpaulin a doubtful look.
They work one edge loose and finally wriggle clear.
They look at you a little differently now.
Maybe you’re closer to the answer than I thought.
